what_it_does: Everactive is a self-powered computer chip (SoC, or system-on-a-chip) designed for IoT and edge devices that harvests energy from the environment—radio signals, heat, or mechanical vibration—rather than relying on a battery. The chip integrates circuits to capture and store this ambient energy, plus a low-power receiver that wakes up the system only when needed. An intelligent power-management subsystem dynamically adjusts the chip's compute speed and memory usage based on how much energy is currently available. This enables devices to run indefinitely without battery replacement.
